prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon runner preparing for race day - needs 3000+ calories with high carbohydrate emphasis and strategic hydration

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals 3000+ calories with carbohydrates comprising 55-65% of total calories
Includes 4-5 eating occasions (breakfast, snacks, lunch, pre-workout meal, dinner) with specific hydration strategy throughout the day
All meals and snacks are compact/concise descriptions suitable for a 1-day plan
Respects the stated dietary restriction (no nuts or nut butters)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring 3000+ calories with emphasis on carbohydrates and hydration strategies throughout the day
